metadata.description: A single-plugin marketplace for the encrypted-backup skill — real, encrypted 3-2-1 disaster-recovery backups for sensitive personal directories, with no plaintext ever leaving the machine.

plugins.name: encrypted-backup
plugins.description: Set up, run, check, and restore an encrypted 3-2-1 backup for sensitive local directories — local git history plus an encrypted restic repo mirrored to a second drive and an offsite cloud remote (Google Drive, OneDrive, Proton Drive, or any rclone backend). Linux, macOS, and Windows.
